title: Topology of Surfaces
description: Stretch a surface any way, without tearing, and one number never changes: V − E + F. A sphere has 2, a doughnut 0. Unlocks the Topology Kiln.

puzzle.goal: A net of V corners, E edges and F faces is drawn on a surface. Write the number χ that no stretching can change.
puzzle.name: Euler characteristic
puzzle.ask: Find χ for a cube: V = @{V}, E = @{E}, F = 6.
puzzle.method: Adding an edge across a face adds one face; adding a corner on an edge adds one edge: χ never moves.
